Booth Tarkington, The Magnificent Ambersons.
Standard Ebooks edition: https://standardebooks.org/ebooks/booth-tarkington/the-magnificent-ambersons

People whose words are in the text, and their death years:
- Booth Tarkington, the author, died 1946 (US).

First publication of the text used: 1918 (SE colophon: 'published in 1918'; English Wikipedia confirms The Magnificent Ambersons (1918)).

Why this is public domain:
- United States: the text was first published in 1918, before 1931;
  a published work enters the United States public domain 95 years after
  publication, so this work entered it in 2013.
- Country of origin (US): copyright there lasts for life plus 70 years
  after the death of the last surviving person named above. The last to die
  did so in 1946, so the work entered the public domain there on
  1 January 2017.

The edition's own statement of rights (from the repository's content.opf):
"The source text and artwork in this ebook are believed to be in the United States public domain; that is, they are believed to be free of copyright restrictions in the United States. They may still be copyrighted in other countries, so users located outside of the United States must check their local laws before using this ebook. The creators of, and contributors to, this ebook dedicate their contributions to the worldwide public domain via the terms in the [CC0 1.0 Universal Public Domain Dedication](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/)."

Sources of these facts:
- SE colophon: published 1918; no translator or introducer mentioned
- Wikidata Q893138 (Booth Tarkington, 'American novelist 1869-1946'), P570 = 1946-05-19 (refs: Encyclopaedia Britannica, Find a Grave, IBDB, BnF)
- English Wikipedia 'Booth Tarkington' infobox death_date = 19 May 1946; article cites the Indianapolis Star obituary 'Booth Tarkington Dies', May 20, 1946
